exposure: AGT M235T genotypes (MM, MT and TT)
AGT M235T alleles (M and T alleles)
cohort: 203 pregnant women (61 with preeclampsia and 142 normotensive controls) at a tertiary-care university hospital in Chiang Mai, Thailand
finding: The AGT M235T gene polymorphism was not significantly associated with preeclampsia in this Thai population.
mod_finding: Women with preeclampsia had a higher chance of having an operative delivery and caesarean section.
gest_age: Women with preeclampsia delivered at an earlier gestational age compared to the normotensive group.
birth_weight: Women with preeclampsia had smaller babies compared to the normotensive group.
